title: Hard Mobs
description: Harder Mobs – Randomly arm mobs to make every fight a real challenge!
body:
Hard Mobs makes Minecraft survival more dangerous by giving hostile mobs random weapons and armor.

Instead of fighting the same weak mobs every night, you may encounter zombies with swords, skeletons wearing armor, or other mobs equipped with powerful gear. Every fight becomes unpredictable and more challenging.

This mod is perfect for players who want a harder survival experience without changing the core gameplay of Minecraft.

Features:
• Hostile mobs can spawn with random weapons and armor  
• Makes combat more challenging and unpredictable  
• Lightweight and simple – no complicated mechanics  
• Works well with survival worlds and modpacks  

If you enjoy tougher gameplay and want mobs to actually feel dangerous, Hard Mobs will make every night something to fear.
